verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of exporting/storing Postman collections as plain-text files for git-based version control; it only mentions cloud workspace 'versioning' (postman-docs-18) and CLI/CI integration, not file-based git workflows. Community evidence even suggests Postman has moved toward cloud-only storage rather than local file/git workflows (postman-comm-1, postman-comm-2), reinforcing the absence of this capability in the pack.
